title: Vintage Woodland Procreate 25 Brushes
author: Luna y Mar Studios
description:
Transform your digital artwork with this Vintage Woodland Procreate Brush Set! Perfect for artists and illustrators who want to create rustic, nature-inspired designs, this set includes 25 real vintage illustration stamps digitized from authentic public domain images. Featuring owls, moose, raccoons, foxes, deer, bears, trees, floral elements, plants, and pine cones, these stamps bring the charm of a bygone era to your projects.
Enhance your designs further with 4 unique texture brushes, including halftones, oil textures, gritty oil textures, and a detailed line brush for precision work. Ideal for crafting woodland scenes, rustic invitations, vintage-inspired posters, or cozy home decor art.
✨ What’s Included:
25 vintage woodland illustration stamps
4 texture brushes: foliage painterly, halftones, dry oil, gritty oil, and a detail line brush
🖌️ Why You’ll Love It:
Authentic vintage charm from public domain illustrations
Easy-to-use Procreate format
Versatile for rustic, vintage, and nature-themed projects
📂 Compatibility:
Designed exclusively for use with the Procreate app on iPad.
🎨 Perfect For:
Woodland and rustic designs
Nature-inspired art
Posters, invitations, and digital art projects
Add a touch of vintage woodland magic to your Procreate toolkit today! ✨
